title: Lesson 37: Running a periodic AI health review
description: Grounded in Lesson 37 of the AI Adoption series: what a health review is and how it differs from a steering committee, the five instruments and the single data pack they feed, the ninety-minute agenda with its time boxes, the deferral ledger rule, and how one quarterly sitting at the insurer produced four decisions with names and dates.

questions.question: How does a periodic health review differ from a steering committee?
options: Asking whether what is already funded is still healthy, used, compliant, and worth its cost
Meeting on a quarterly cadence, while a steering committee convenes whenever funding decisions arise
Reviewing a sample of records against an external standard, then issuing findings in a report
Reporting the activities the team completed since the previous meeting of the group
questions.explanation: A steering committee decides whether to fund something, while a health review checks whether what was already funded is still healthy, used, compliant, and worth its cost. One agenda for both lets funding crowd out the work of looking after what you own.

questions.question: An item in the deferral ledger comes due and the group is not ready to decide it. What is the correct handling?
options: Remove it from the ledger until somebody raises the subject again
Defer it again with a new date and a stated reason for the delay
Carry it forward with no date, since the item itself has not changed
Escalate it to the steering committee as a funding question
questions.explanation: Every item whose revisit date has arrived gets a decision, and deferring again with a new date and a reason is a decision. Dropping the date turns the item into a deletion, which is how a deferral quietly becomes permanent.

questions.question: Several near misses share one shape: people paste a document into an unapproved tool because the approved one does not hold it. What response fits?
options: Send a reminder to the group about the rules for handling internal documents
Record each case as an individual training failure and close the items
Load the missing document into the approved tool, then re-run the sampling
Revoke access to the assistant platform until everyone completes retraining
questions.explanation: A repeated near miss with the same shape points at a system defect rather than a group of careless people, because the approved tool did not answer the need. Fix the content gap first, then re-check whether the workaround stops.
